name: bare-bones
description: Generalized fallback hint pack for unusual or polyglot stacks. Hints only — provisioning tailors the actual config to the codebase.
hints: Reference global resources; never copy them into the project.
Generate only what a genuine gap requires — minimal by default.
Derive rules from conventions actually observed in the codebase before inventing any.
Prefer the best tool for the job; do not assume a language.
research: Context7: resolve the primary framework/library and read its conventions
SearXNG: "<stack> project conventions lint test CI 2026"
gh_grep: find real repositories using the same stack and read their config files
